description: Dashboard sign-in: show login_init URL/code for browser approval; poll login_complete. logout signs out. Project keys: rotate/revoke/list/reissue. login, login_complete, rotate and reissue store credentials; logout and revoke remove them.

keyId.description: revoke: defaults to project key. logout: user key; required if several

maxWaitSeconds.description: login_complete: default 30s; pending means retry same code

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Default 2s; pass the device code's interval

name: rbook_auth
title: Dashboard authentication
